notes: Prompts and seeds for self-generating Insight Corruption's five required identity assets (asset-registry.json) with open-weight models, per docs/guides/ASSET_PROCUREMENT.md and modal/generate_production_audio.py. Fixed seeds make regeneration reproducible: same model version + prompt + seed should reproduce the same output, which is the basis for calling this 'consistent' rather than a one-off lucky take. A model upgrade (e.g. a new ACE-Step checkpoint) is expected to change output even with the same seed — pin modelLicense/model to the exact version actually used and regenerate deliberately, not silently.

assets.prompt: Modern investigative documentary theme, instrumental, no vocals. 88 BPM. Sparse low percussion and a steady pulse, restrained sub bass, one subtle textural synth or organic instrumental element for color. Recognizable and identifiable within two seconds, restrained rather than cinematic-horror, leaves clear space for a spoken voice-over on top. Clean, deliberate ending button, not a fade.
assets.followUp: 60-90s + stems + 15/30s cutdowns is the brief. This generates one ~75s master only; stems and cutdowns are a manual follow-up (trim/re-render at shorter duration with the same seed+prompt, or split stems with a source-separation pass) once the master itself is approved.

assets.modelLicense: Apache-2.0 (github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5) - unconditional commercial use, no revenue threshold
assets.prompt: Instrumental underscore for evidence review and timeline narration in an investigative documentary podcast. No vocals, no lead melody. Minimal harmonic movement, low rhythmic pulse, sparse texture. Designed to sit quietly beneath spoken narration, roughly 20-26 dB under a voice track, without pulling attention away from it. Even, unchanging energy throughout with no big builds or drops.
assets.followUp: Requested as a 2-4 minute seamless loop; this generates a single 180s pass. Verify the loop point (first vs. last ~2s) before use and, if it's not clean, crossfade-loop it with ffmpeg or trim to a cleanly loopable region rather than shipping an audible seam.

assets.prompt: Instrumental underscore for a closing reflection and known-versus-unknown analysis segment in an investigative documentary podcast. No vocals. assets.followUp: Same 2-4 minute seamless-loop caveat as the investigation bed: verify or engineer the loop point before use.
